nodes.description: mapping(address=>uint256) _rOwned: reflection-denominated balances used for fee-on-transfer reflection accounting.
mapping(address=>uint256) _tOwned: token-denominated balances for addresses excluded from reflection rewards.
mapping(address=>mapping(address=>uint256)) _allowances: ERC20 spending allowances.
mapping(address=>bool) _isExcludedFromFee: addresses that bypass tax/liquidity/funding fees.
mapping(address=>bool) _isExcluded: addresses excluded from reflection reward distribution.
uint256 _tTotal: total token supply (1e15 * 1e9).
uint256 _rTotal: total reflections, basis for the reflection rate.
uint256 _tFeeTotal: accumulated token fees distributed through reflection.
uint256 _taxFee / _previousTaxFee: reflection tax rate, mutable at runtime.
uint256 _liquidityFee / _previousLiquidityFee: liquidity fee rate, mutable at runtime.
uint256 _fundingFee / _previousFundingFee: marketing/charity/dev funding fee rate.
address charityAddress: owner-controlled destination of the charity & marketing share.
address communityAddress: owner-controlled marketing destination.
address DevWallet: owner-controlled dev/team tax destination.
IUniswapV2Router02 immutable uniswapV2Router: external router used for swaps and liquidity.
address immutable uniswapV2Pair: the token/WETH pair created in the constructor.
bool inSwapAndLiquify: reentrancy-style guard flag for the swap-and-liquify routine.
bool swapAndLiquifyEnabled: owner switch controlling automatic swap+liquify on transfers.
uint256 _maxTxAmount: owner-controlled maximum transfer size for non-excluded accounts.
address _owner / _previousOwner / _lockTime: Ownable ownership and time-lock state.
constructor: mints full reflection supply to deployer, deploys/derives the Uniswap pair, sets fee exemptions.
transfer(address,uint256): ERC20 transfer routed through the internal _transfer engine.
transferFrom(address,address,uint256): transfers and decrements allowance.
approve(address,uint256): sets allowance via the private _approve helper.
balanceOf(address): returns _tOwned for excluded accounts, otherwise tokenFromReflection(_rOwned).
_transfer(address,address,uint256) private: validation, min-balance check, optional swapAndLiquify, then _tokenTransfer.
swapAndLiquify(uint256) private lockTheSwap: swaps half the contract tokens to ETH and adds liquidity to Uniswap.
swapTokensForEth(uint256) private: approves and calls the router swap with block.timestamp deadline.
addLiquidity(uint256,uint256) private: approves token and calls addLiquidityETH with 0 slippage and block.timestamp.
_tokenTransfer(address,address,uint256) private: applies/removes fees, computes burn/funding splits and dispatches to the transfer variants.
_transferStandard: reflection transfer between two non-excluded accounts.
_transferToExcluded: transfer from non-excluded sender into an excluded recipient.
_transferFromExcluded: transfer from an excluded sender to a non-excluded recipient.
_transferBothExcluded: transfer between two reflection-excluded accounts.
removeAllFee(): unguarded public function zeroing tax, liquidity, burn and funding fees.
restoreAllFee(): sets fees back to hardcoded defaults (2/2/0/6).
excludeFromReward(address) onlyOwner: converts reflection balance to token balance and marks account excluded.
includeInReward(address) onlyOwner: re-includes an account and pops it from the _excluded array.
deliver(uint256): public reflection accounting that reduces caller _rOwned and _rTotal.
setMaxTxPercent(uint256) onlyOwner: recomputes _maxTxAmount as a percentage of _tTotal.
setSwapAndLiquifyEnabled(bool) onlyOwner: toggles automatic swap+liquify.
lock(uint256) onlyOwner: renounces owner and stores _lockTime = now + time.
unlock(): restores _previousOwner when msg.sender matches and now < _lockTime.
msg.sender via _msgSender(): attacker-controlled caller identity used for auth and transfer routing.
block.timestamp / now: miner-influenced value used as swap deadline and lock timing.
External router call swapExactTokensForETHSupportingFeeOnTransferTokens with amountOutMin = 0 (unbounded slippage, external code execution).
External payable router call addLiquidityETH with both minimums = 0 (value transfer plus external code execution).
Parameter `from` of _transfer: source address of the internal transfer.
Parameter `to` of _transfer: destination address of the internal transfer.
Parameter `amount` of _transfer: token amount being moved.
Parameter `account` of balanceOf/isExcluded: queried address.
Parameter `tAmount` of the _transferStandard family: token amount to convert to reflection amounts.
Parameter `spender` of approve: allowance beneficiary.
Parameter `recipient` of transfer: destination address.
Local `contractTokenBalance` in _transfer: balanceOf(address(this)) evaluated before swapping.
Local `half` in swapAndLiquify: first half of contract tokens swapped to ETH.
Local `otherHalf` in swapAndLiquify: remainder used for adding liquidity.
Local `newBalance` in swapAndLiquify: ETH delta produced by the swap.
Local `burnAmt` in _tokenTransfer: amount computed from _burnFee.
Local `fundingAmt` in _tokenTransfer: amount computed from _fundingFee.
Local `fundingPiece` in _tokenTransfer: sixth of the funding amount distributed to wallets.

edges.reason: Constructor derives the deployer balance from _msgSender() (attacker-independent at deploy but still caller-derived state).
transfer uses _msgSender() as the sender address.
transferFrom uses _msgSender() as the spender whose allowance is decremented.
approve stores allowances for _msgSender().
deliver derives the sender from _msgSender() and mutates reflection state for that caller.
unlock authorization depends solely on msg.sender equalling _previousOwner combined with a timestamp lock window.
The router swap deadline is block.timestamp, making swap execution time-dependent.
addLiquidityETH deadline is block.timestamp, making liquidity execution time-dependent.
lock() sets _lockTime = now + time, and unlock() compares now < _lockTime, a miner-influenced lock window.
External `from` argument flows into _transfer and is used for validation and balance debit.
External `to` argument flows into _transfer for validation and balance credit.
External `amount` argument flows into _transfer and drives fee and split computation.
`from` is forwarded as `sender` into _tokenTransfer and used for balance mutations.
`amount` flows into _tokenTransfer and is multiplied/divided to derive burn and funding amounts.
tAmount parameter is passed to _getValues inside _transferStandard to derive r/t amounts.
spender parameter is written into the _allowances mapping.
recipient parameter is the destination passed into the internal transfer engine.
account parameter indexes _isExcluded and _rOwned inside balanceOf.
transfer delegates to the private _transfer routine.
transferFrom delegates to the private _transfer routine before adjusting allowance.
transferFrom calls the allowance-setting approve path via _approve.
_transfer conditionally invokes swapAndLiquify when the contract balance exceeds the threshold.
_transfer calls _tokenTransfer to apply fees and move balances.
_tokenTransfer dispatches to _transferStandard for the standard/excluded fallback case.
_tokenTransfer dispatches to _transferToExcluded when only the recipient is excluded.
_tokenTransfer dispatches to _transferFromExcluded when only the sender is excluded.
_tokenTransfer dispatches to _transferBothExcluded when both parties are excluded.
swapAndLiquify calls swapTokensForEth for half of the contract token balance.
swapAndLiquify calls addLiquidity with the remaining half and the swapped ETH.
swapAndLiquify performs an external router swap call while the inSwapAndLiquify guard is set, exposing the liquidity flow to reentrant callbacks.
swapAndLiquify forwards ETH through addLiquidityETH, an external payable call that can execute untrusted code.
The lockTheSwap modifier gates swapAndLiquify using inSwapAndLiquify, the only reentrancy shield in the contract.
swapAndLiquify toggles inSwapAndLiquify to true before and false after the external interactions.
balanceOf reads _rOwned to compute reflection-derived balances.
balanceOf returns _tOwned directly for reflection-excluded accounts.
_transferStandard debits and credits _rOwned for both parties.
_transferStandard feeds liquidity into _tOwned when the contract is excluded.
_tokenTransfer temporarily zeroes and later restores _taxFee around wallet distributions.
_tokenTransfer temporarily zeroes and restores _liquidityFee.
_tokenTransfer temporarily zeroes and restores _fundingFee while sending funding shares.
_tokenTransfer calls removeAllFee for fee-exempt senders/recipients, mutating global fee state mid-transaction.
_tokenTransfer calls restoreAllFee at the end of fee-exempt transfers.
removeAllFee is publicly callable without onlyOwner and writes _taxFee/_liquidityFee/_burnFee/_fundingFee to zero.
restoreAllFee is publicly callable without onlyOwner and overwrites the fee configuration.
setMaxTxPercent computes _maxTxAmount = _tTotal * maxTxPercent / 100 with only an implicit SafeMath bound.
setMaxTxPercent reads _tTotal as the basis for the new maximum transaction amount.
setSwapAndLiquifyEnabled writes the swapAndLiquifyEnabled flag.
_tokenTransfer enforces amount <= _maxTxAmount for non-fee-exempt participants.
_transfer reads swapAndLiquifyEnabled to decide whether to run the liquidity routine.
_transfer reads inSwapAndLiquify to avoid recursive liquidity events.
_transfer compares from against uniswapV2Pair to avoid swapping on pair-initiated transfers.
_transfer computes contractTokenBalance via balanceOf(address(this)) before the swap decision.
swapAndLiquify derives half by dividing the contract token balance.
swapAndLiquify computes otherHalf as the balance remainder.
swapAndLiquify measures newBalance as the ETH delta created by the external swap.
_tokenTransfer computes burnAmt = amount * _burnFee / 100.
_tokenTransfer computes fundingAmt = amount * _fundingFee / 100.
_tokenTransfer computes fundingPiece = fundingAmt / 6 for the three recipient wallets.
_tokenTransfer sends fundingPiece*2 to charityAddress.
_tokenTransfer sends fundingPiece*2 to communityAddress.
_tokenTransfer sends fundingPiece*2 to DevWallet.
Constructor stores the uniswapV2Router address used by all liquidity operations.
Constructor creates and stores the uniswapV2Pair via the factory.
Constructor marks owner and the contract itself as excluded from fees.
Constructor assigns the entire _rTotal to the deployer's _rOwned entry.
excludeFromReward flips _isExcluded and pushes the account onto the _excluded array.
includeInReward clears _isExcluded during the array compaction loop.
includeInReward zeroes _tOwned for the re-included account.
deliver debits the caller's _rOwned by the computed rAmount.
deliver accumulates tAmount into _tFeeTotal.
swapTokensForEth directly invokes the untrusted router swap with zero minimum output.
addLiquidity directly invokes the untrusted payable router call with zero slippage bounds.
lock moves _owner into _previousOwner and clears _owner.
unlock restores _owner from _previousOwner after checking the caller and lock time.
unlock writes _owner from _previousOwner based on a msg.sender equality check and timestamp comparison.

normalization_plan.reason: `from` is an input of _transfer only and must be folded into the transfer function node.
`to` is an input of _transfer only and must be folded into the transfer function node.
`account` only indexes mappings read by balanceOf.
`tAmount` is the amount argument consumed by the standard transfer variant.
`spender` is written into _allowances by the approve path.
`recipient` is the destination argument of the external transfer entrypoint.
contractTokenBalance is a temporary computed inside _transfer and has no independent identity.
`half` exists only as scratch arithmetic inside swapAndLiquify.
`otherHalf` exists only as scratch arithmetic inside swapAndLiquify.
`newBalance` is the transient ETH measurement used by swapAndLiquify.
burnAmt is a transient fee component computed in _tokenTransfer.
fundingAmt is a transient fee component computed in _tokenTransfer.
fundingPiece is a transient split value computed in _tokenTransfer.
